Chapter 1057: Chapter 10: Eye of Myriad Laws and Martial Arts Evolution Road (Please Subscribe)_3

“The path of Martial Arts Evolution, if only circulated within human civilization, is still too slow.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, how many citizens does all of human civilization have, really? Even if everyone practiced martial arts, it would still be difficult to form an ‘anchor’ solid enough to stabilize a life form of Lin Yuan’s magnitude.

“Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion?”

Lin Yuan thought of that mysterious organization, spreading across countless Chaos Continents, and even spanning various Void Domains.

With the influence of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, it would be much easier to disseminate the path of Martial Arts Evolution.

“I need to visit Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.”

Lin Yuan made up his mind. Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion not only sells various evolution paths but also collects them.

Buzz.

Within the ‘Fragment World’ of Star Tears, Lin Yuan condensed a projection of himself, descending toward the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent below.

“Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion?”

Lin Yuan headed straight to the front of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, gazing at the exquisite and magnificent pavilion before him.

“Remarkable.”

Lin Yuan carefully observed Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion. Each time he viewed it, he had a different experience. After stepping into the Twelfth Layer, crossing the threshold of life’s essence, he further sensed the terrifying nature of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

From the records left behind by the lineage of Profound Xuanhuang, Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion was described as something that should never be provoked unless absolutely necessary.

Even Xuanhuang, the peerless Great Saint of that caliber, deeply feared Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

Of course, any living being—so long as they adhere to the rules established by Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion—would generally not face any problem, which was the reason Lin Yuan dared to come.

The influence of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion was terrifying, but its essence was simply that of a trading hub, valuing fairness above all.

“Sigh.”

Lin Yuan stepped directly into Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

At the moment, the interior of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion was bustling with activity. Numerous Twelfth Layer beings were coming and going.

Twelfth Layer beings entered Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion partly to search for a suitable cultivation path for their descendants and offspring, and partly to seek a replacement path for themselves.

Many Twelfth Layer beings were stuck at bottlenecks, unable to advance for countless Cosmic Eras. The main reason often lay in their current path not being perfectly compatible with them.

Their understanding of laws, physical form, and soul—all had reached the thresholds for breakthrough. Yet, they still could not step into the next level, or each attempted breakthrough had ended in failure.

It was time to consider whether the evolution path itself was the issue.

If they could find a more suitable path, while it might involve the risk of ‘shattering the Dao,’ it also held the hope of progressing further.

Rustle.

Lin Yuan continued to walk deeper inside. The sky and earth seemed to transform, and he quickly reached an independent space where countless runes hovered faintly around the void.

“Please select a purpose: 1. Purchase an evolution path; 2. Sell an evolution path; 3. Other.”

An utterly emotionless voice echoed in Lin Yuan’s ears.

“Straightforward.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

“Sell an evolution path.”

Lin Yuan chose the second option.

Soon.

The emotionless voice repeated:

“Place the evolution path you wish to sell onto the platform.”

Before Lin Yuan lay a platform entirely constructed of black stone.

Lin Yuan pondered briefly, then flipped his hand to produce a jade scroll. It contained the records of a specific branch of the Martial Arts Evolution path.

This evolution path, named the Life and Death Martial Dao, was one that Lin Yuan had meticulously refined. Unlike the branch tailored specifically for human civilization, it was nearly universally applicable to any life form possessing flesh and blood.

Buzz!

The jade scroll floated above the black stone platform.

…

Deep within Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion’s inner space.

An elderly Daoist holding a wine gourd was dozing off.

At that moment, the elder seemed to awaken abruptly, mumbling: “Another evolution path with the potential to reach the Realm of Dominion… requires my confirmation…”

As the Pavilion Master of this branch of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, the elder rarely handled routine matters. Only when collecting evolution paths—especially those reaching certain thresholds—was a secondary confirmation necessary.

Collecting evolution paths required Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion to expend Chaos Stones, so repeated verification was naturally essential.

“Let me take a look.”

The elder stretched lazily and murmured, “This evolution path, named Life and Death Martial Dao? It utilizes the forces of life and death to refine both the physical body and the soul…”

The more the elder examined the path, the more intrigued he became. He faintly sensed that this evolution path seemed to hold potential far beyond the boundaries of the Realm of Dominion.

“Hmm… It lacks the ultimate foundational traits of the Twelfth Layer.”

The elder roughly analyzed the path and deliberated inwardly.

“I’m somewhat unsure…”

The elder furrowed slightly in confusion. He could discern that the path’s details were exceedingly refined—logically, it shouldn’t be limited to mere Dominion potential.

“Could it be a Chaos Realm evolution path?”

He speculated in his heart, “No, if it involves the Chaos Realm, I’d better consult the Eye of Myriad Laws for verification.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws governs the operations of all branches of Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion. Each pavilion has the ability to summon a projection of it.

The main Ten Thousand Paths Tower resides in the most enigmatic part of the Chaos Void, rumored to have been created by the Eye of Myriad Laws.

Xuan Huang once made various conjectures about the Eye of Myriad Laws, ultimately hypothesizing that it might be an ancient relic left by a Thirteenth-Layer temporal life form.

“Universal laws and paths, extending everywhere.”

The elder, still holding the wine gourd, stood up and entered an octagonal hall, activating the floating runes in the void around him.

Within moments.

A vortex gradually appeared before the elder, from which a colossal eye was faintly projected.

“The Eye of Myriad Laws.”

The elder adopted a respectful demeanor.

The immense eye, its iris golden, towered above the elder.

“This is the evolution path.”

The elder wasted no words, immediately presenting the Life and Death Martial Dao and placing it before him.

The Eye of Myriad Laws turned its golden iris slightly, fixing its gaze on the Life and Death Martial Dao.

In an instant, deep within the colossal pupil of the Eye of Myriad Laws, the threads of time faintly extended, forming a trajectory of the Life and Death Martial Dao.

This trajectory stretched continuously forward, ultimately piercing through the infinite depths of chaos.

“This evolution path?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws seemed to perceive something, and its immense pupil subtly contracted.
